test_title: PYST 34: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Tejasvi drove at an average speed of 35 miles/h for the first 35 miles of a trip and then at an average speed of 65 miles/h for the remaining 35 miles of the trip. If she made no stops during the trip, what was her average speed (in miles/h) for the entire trip?
solution:
**Given:**

35 miles in 35miles/h speed

35 miles for 65mies/h speed

**Formua used:**

Speed = Distance/Time 

Average speed = Total Distance / Total Time taken

**Solution:**

Case 1:

distance = 35 miles

speed = 35miles/h

time = 35/35 = 1 hour

Case 2:

distance = 35 miles

speed = 65miles/h

time = 35/65 = 7/13 hours

Average speed = (35 + 35) / (1 + 7/13) = 70/(20/13) = 91/2 = 45.5miles/h

**The average speed is 45.5miles/h.**
